Announcements.Title: Critical update: frame dragging fix
Announcements.Body: DesktopPossible 1.1.2 fixes a bug where frames would not move when dragged slowly with grid snapping on, and only jumped a cell at a time when dragged quickly. Please update to keep frames moving smoothly.

Announcements.Title: DesktopPossible 1.1 is here
Announcements.Body: DesktopPossible 1.1 remembers your frame layout for each display configuration, so docking and undocking no longer scrambles your desktop. Downloads are now digitally signed by DevPossible LLC, which means Windows recognises the publisher instead of warning about an unknown one.
